name: zrndr_overlay_blend_row565_mmx
description: zRndr::OverlayBlendRow565_Mmx blends packed RGB565 software overlay rows in four-pixel blocks.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48d5f0 validates a four-pixel RGB565 MMX qword loop with channel masks, destination scale, premultiplied overlay terms, and EMMS cleanup.

The native smoke verifies FlushSw selects the RGB565 MMX-path helper when graphics flag 0x4 is set and blends a four-pixel row to the overlay color; the source keeps only the qword MMX loop in inline asm because VC5SP3 has no MMX intrinsic surface.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 byte verification evidence from python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 zrndr_overlay_blend_rows --auto-chunk: 0x48d5f0 matches with zero unmasked byte mismatches after COFF relocation masking under vc5_o2_ob0_md_zrndr_mmx_raw_asm_facs; 16 relocation bytes masked, one trim nop, BN body size 223, VC5 symbol size 224; artifacts are build/vc5-verify/zrndr_overlay_blend_rows/zRndr.obj, zRndr.cod, and verify/48d5f0_*.
